name: WinPmem
description: Acquire physical memory from a running Windows machine to a raw image file.
about: WinPmem captures the contents of physical memory so it can be examined afterwards with something else. It loads a signed driver, reads memory through it, and writes a raw image that memory analysis tools read directly. Acquisition is the step everything else depends on and cannot be repeated: the machine keeps running while the capture proceeds, so the image is a smear across the time it took rather than an instant, and anything overwritten in the meantime is gone. Administrator rights are required, since loading a driver is what reading physical memory needs.
